notes.title: v1.5 Major Update 2024/12/10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293354/2cc687eaee7c47d0c50e979e8e535e146535573e.png[/img]

New content:
1. Added 3 endings
2. The first mate lengthened the plot of [boss's car] (added plot dialogue and two animated pictures)
3. Added a long ending plot animation
4. Added NTR Hall full plot appreciation (open in the CG appreciation column after completing 4 endings)

Adjustments:
1. Now you can use the mouse to interact with the scene
2. Now you can use the mouse to read the plot

Fixes:
1. Fixed the bug that the mouse cannot move at 4K resolution
2. Fixed the bug that the display prompt flickers at 4K resolution
3. Fixed the bug that the display does not appear after delivering food to the president's office
4. Fixed the known buttons that are not translated into English
5. Fixed the known model crossing problem

If you have any questions or bugs, please leave a message below. Updating is not easy, and I hope you will support me with good comments. Thank you!

notes.title: V1.4.2 Version update 2024/12/2
notes.content:
New content:
1. After passing once, you can choose to open the All CG (strongly not recommended)
2. Added ending condition prompts. Each time an ending is played, the conditions for achieving the next ending will be given
